words.example: They solved the conflict without angry words.

example_translations.ru: Они разрешили конфликт без резких слов.
example_translations.uz: Ular nizoni achchiq so'zlarsiz hal qilishdi.

words.example: Don't blame me for your own mistakes!

example_translations.ru: Не вините меня в своих собственных ошибках!

words.example: The guests complained about the noise at night.
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

example_translations.ru: Простите, я не хотел вас обидеть.
example_translations.uz: Kechirasiz, men sizni xafa qilmoqchi emas edim.

words.example: My parents had an argument about our vacation.

example_translations.ru: У моих родителей вышел спор из-за нашего отпуска.
example_translations.uz: Ota-onam o'rtasida ta'tilimiz haqida bahs bo'ldi.

words.example: It was my fault that we were late.
He criticizes everyone but never listens to others.

example_translations.ru: Он критикует всех, но никогда не слушает других.
example_translations.uz: U hammani tanqid qiladi, lekin hech qachon boshqalarga quloq solmaydi.

words.example: My sister never admits her own mistakes.

example_translations.ru: Моя сестра никогда не признаёт своих ошибок.
example_translations.uz: Singlim hech qachon o'z xatolarini tan olmaydi.

words.example: The boy denied that he broke the window.
We often disagree, but we are still friends.

example_translations.ru: Мы часто не соглашаемся друг с другом, но всё равно остаёмся друзьями.
example_translations.uz: Biz ko'pincha bir-birimizning fikriga qo'shilmaymiz, lekin baribir do'stmiz.
